visual_evidence: The bitmap contains two disconnected black material regions, mirrored about the horizontal centerline.
Both guides span the full 40 um length and are approximately 0.52 um wide.
The guide centers start near +/-1.97 um, bend inward to coupled centers near +/-0.36 um, run parallel through a long central section, and bend back out at the right edge.
The coupled-section inner gap is approximately 0.20 um.
topology_reasoning.working_model: Two mirrored centerline paths extruded on layer (1,0). Each path has a cosine S-bend from the input pitch to the central coupling pitch, a straight coupled transfer section, and a mirrored cosine S-bend to the output pitch.
topology_reasoning.how_it_works: Optical power transfer is set primarily by the parallel interaction length and the small central gap between the two single-mode guides; the S-bend length and pitch set adiabatic access to the coupling region with low radiation and define the footprint.
topology_reasoning.verification_note: homi.spec_optimization.verify_knob_response is a one-arm length-delta helper. A symmetric coupler transfer-length knob changes both guides and leaves arm delta at zero, so this recreation also exposes a baseline-zero delta_length trim knob that moves real layer-(1,0) geometry without altering the matched baseline image.

iterations.change_made: Initial primitives-only cosine-S directional-coupler model with wg_width=0.54, gap_um=0.18, input_pitch=3.96, sbend_length=9.6, coupling_length=20.8. Diff shows small systematic S-bend curvature mismatch but exact footprint and threshold-passing overlap.
